# Donor CRM with Pledge Tracking

I'll create a comprehensive donor management system with pledge tracking capabilities.

```python
import os
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Optional
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, String, Float, DateTime, ForeignKey, Enum as SQLEnum, Boolean, Text
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, relationship
import enum

Base = declarative_base()

class DonorType(enum.Enum):
    INDIVIDUAL = "Individual"
    CORPORATION = "Corporation"
    FOUNDATION = "Foundation"
    ORGANIZATION = "Organization"

class PledgeStatus(enum.Enum):
    PENDING = "Pending"
    ACTIVE = "Active"
    COMPLETED = "Completed"
    DEFAULTED = "Defaulted"
    CANCELLED = "Cancelled"

class PaymentStatus(enum.Enum):
    PENDING = "Pending"
    COMPLETED = "Completed"
    FAILED = "Failed"
    REFUNDED = "Refunded"

class PaymentMethod(enum.Enum):
    CASH = "Cash"
    CHECK = "Check"
    CREDIT_CARD = "Credit Card"
    BANK_TRANSFER = "Bank Transfer"
    ONLINE = "Online"

# Database Models

class Donor(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'donors'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    donor_type = Column(SQLEnum(DonorType), nullable=False)
    first_name = Column(String(100))
    last_name = Column(String(100))
    organization_name = Column(String(200))
    email = Column(String(200), unique=True)
    phone = Column(String(20))
    address = Column(Text)
    city = Column(String(100))
    state = Column(String(50))
    zip_code = Column(String(20))
    country = Column(String(100), default="USA")
    
    # Relationship tracking
    acquisition_date = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    acquisition_source = Column(String(100))
    
    # Communication preferences
    email_opt_in = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    mail_opt_in = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    
    # Notes
    notes = Column(Text)
    
    # Relationships
    pledges = relationship("Pledge", back_populates="donor", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    donations = relationship("Donation", back_populates="donor", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    interactions = relationship("Interaction", back_populates="donor", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)
    
    def get_full_name(self):
        if self.donor_type == DonorType.INDIVIDUAL:
            return f"{self.first_name} {self.last_name}"
        return self.organization_name
    
    def get_total_donated(self):
        return sum(d.amount for d in self.donations if d.payment_status == PaymentStatus.COMPLETED)
    
    def get_total_pledged(self):
        return sum(p.total_amount for p in self.pledges if p.status in [PledgeStatus.ACTIVE, PledgeStatus.PENDING])
    
    def get_outstanding_pledges(self):
        return sum(p.get_remaining_amount() for p in self.pledges if p.status == PledgeStatus.ACTIVE)

class Campaign(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'campaigns'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = Column(String(200), nullable=False)
    description = Column(Text)
    goal_amount = Column(Float, default=0.0)
    start_date = Column(DateTime)
    end_date = Column(DateTime)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    
    # Relationships
    pledges = relationship("Pledge", back_populates="campaign")
    donations = relationship("Donation", back_populates="campaign")
    
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    
    def get_total_raised(self):
        return sum(d.amount for d in self.donations if d.payment_status == PaymentStatus.COMPLETED)
    
    def get_total_pledged(self):
        return sum(p.total_amount for p in self.pledges if p.status in [PledgeStatus.ACTIVE, PledgeStatus.PENDING])
    
    def get_progress_percentage(self):
        if self.goal_amount == 0:
            return 0
        return (self.get_total_raised() / self.goal_amount) * 100

class Pledge(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'pledges'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    donor_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('donors.id'), nullable=False)
    campaign_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('campaigns.id'))
    
    total_amount = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    frequency = Column(String(50))  # One-time, Monthly, Quarterly, Annual
    installments = Column(Integer, default=1)
    installment_amount = Column(Float)
    
    status = Column(SQLEnum(PledgeStatus), default=PledgeStatus.PENDING)
    
    pledge_date = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    start_date = Column(DateTime)
    end_date = Column(DateTime)
    
    notes = Column(Text)
    
    # Relationships
    donor = relationship("Donor", back_populates="pledges")
    campaign = relationship("Campaign", back_populates="pledges")
    payments = relationship("PledgePayment", back_populates="pledge", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)
    
    def get_total_paid(self):
        return sum(p.amount for p in self.payments if p.status == PaymentStatus.COMPLETED)
    
    def get_remaining_amount(self):
        return self.total_amount - self.get_total_paid()
    
    def get_completion_percentage(self):
        if self.total_amount == 0:
            return 0
        return (self.get_total_paid() / self.total_amount) * 100

class PledgePayment(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'pledge_payments'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    pledge_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('pledges.id'), nullable=False)
    
    amount = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    scheduled_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False)
    payment_date = Column(DateTime)
    
    status = Column(SQLEnum(PaymentStatus), default=PaymentStatus.PENDING)
    payment_method = Column(SQLEnum(PaymentMethod))
    
    transaction_id = Column(String(100))
    notes = Column(Text)
    
    # Relationships
    pledge = relationship("Pledge", back_populates="payments")
    
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)

class Donation(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'donations'
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    donor_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('donors.id'), nullable=False)
    campaign_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('campaigns.id'))
    pledge_payment_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('pledge_payments.id'))
    
    amount = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    donation_date = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
